headline: Can Danaher (DHR) Trade At A Discount After Its CEO Change?
summary: Danaher stock now sits around US$194.78 after a weak earnings update and a leadership change on the horizon, and investors are weighing a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) intrinsic value estimate that points to upside against market multiples that still flag the shares as expensive. Over the past 5 years, Danaher shares have declined about 27.1%, which means long term holders are still under water even before considering valuation.
